title: Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Performance Optimization (FSLogix)
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: optimize endpoint performance (login times, profiles, session stability).

Scope: cut login times + stabilize sessions on shared clinical Windows endpoints (and AVD) using FSLogix Profile Containers + fast-logon tuning; before/after measurement; interplay with Imprivata tap-and-go. White-label.
pricing: T3 (advanced) — FSLogix + profile storage + fast-logon tuning, measured.
